family_realization.note: Passage executes 'The Half-Life' with surgical precision. Traces 'resilience' from Holling's 1973 measurable definition through psychology, urban planning, banking, documenting each constraint shed. Author's ambivalence is sustained: 'that is not nothing' and 'uncomfortable possibility' block contempt while charting decay.

ending_behavior.note: 'Whether the consoling version thereby earns its keep...cannot settle alone — and here the historians of scientific language...are the better-instrumented witnesses.' Displaces to historiography rather than resolving. Aperture 'displaces' realized; reader exits into different discipline's jurisdiction.

voice_consistency.note: Sustained epistemic auditing throughout. 'How do we know this term does work?' drives every move. 'The audit turns on itself' and 'the epistemics of concept-drift cannot settle alone' are diagnostic, not decorative. No generic AI-essay register present.

distractor_efficiency.note: Q1(A): causal_inversion — 'cut loose' makes constraints irrelevant, not protective. Q2(C): causal_inversion — rehearsed possibility misread as endorsement. Q5(B): false_symmetry — passage insists they 'never rivals.' Q6(B): stance_misread — author questions if 'corruption' is right frame. All nameably genuine choices, not lexical extremity.

explanation_quality.note: Each wrong-option explanation ties to passage location. Q1(B) quotes 'paragraph 4 explicitly questions...corruption.' Q3(A) identifies 'deferral as resolved verdict' vice versa. Q5(C) mechanics the premise severing usefulness from measurement. Never resorts to 'not mentioned'; traces specific inversion, scope, or stage errors.
